Home/About

A room in Jabalpur,
and one simple idea.

That the best nights are the ones where you're not performing for a room full of strangers.

Ask us anything Leave your number and we'll call you back.

Why we're building this

There are plenty of places in Jabalpur to sit in a room with other people. There are very few where the room is yours — where you can put on the thing you actually want to watch, sing badly, propose, or just sit with your people without someone clearing the table around you.

So that's what we're building. One private space you book by the session. The room doesn't change; what we put in it does. You tell us what the night is, we set it up before you arrive, and then we get out of the way.

How we want to run it

A few things we've decided up front, because they're easier to hold to if we say them out loud:

  • Price it once, honestly. Everything we charge for is on the tickets page. If it isn't listed there, we don't charge for it.
  • One booking at a time. We won't sell two groups into the same room and call it private.
  • Say no when it won't work. If the room doesn't suit what you're planning, we'd rather tell you that than take the booking.
  • No invented numbers. You won't find a review count or a "10,000 celebrations hosted" on this site, because we haven't opened yet. When we have real numbers, we'll show real numbers.

Where we are right now

Setting up. The room is being finished, the equipment is being sorted, and we're taking pre-bookings so we know which nights people actually want. Pre-booking costs nothing and commits you to nothing — it just tells us you're interested, and puts you near the front when we open.

To do

Who we are, how YourSpace started, and photographs of the room go here before launch. We'd rather leave this honest and unfinished than fill it with something invented.

Talk to us

If you're planning something and you're not sure the room fits, ask. If you want to work with us, or you're a local act who wants a room for a night, ask that too. Contact us here.
